Subject: 25% off the Beacon Headlamp — through Tuesday
Preview: 400 lumens, 40-hour runtime, 95 g. Your next trip just got a little lighter.
Body: Whether you're starting a pre-dawn approach or finishing a longer-than-planned descent, the Northbay Beacon Headlamp is built for the kind of nights you actually plan around.

400 lumens of output handles most trail and camp tasks — reading a topo, cooking, moving through tree cover. It's not designed for technical caving or search-and-rescue distances, but for backpacking and general trail use it holds its own.

The runtime is 40 hours, so a weekend trip rarely requires a recharge. When you do need to top it up, USB-C means one cable handles it. The whole unit weighs 95 g — light enough to forget it's on your head.

Through Tuesday, the Beacon is 25% off. No complicated codes. Just a straightforward discount on a light we stand behind.
